description: Decentralized trust infrastructure for autonomous AI agents on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31). An admin initialises global config and an insurance pool against a SWORN mint; agents later post an identity bond, bid on contracts, and can be disputed.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/trust-protocol fork. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize, and later identity-bond / contract flows)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/trust-protocol/
QA: devnet proof of initialize against a 6-decimal SWORN mint, config read-back, and a rejected second initialize
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Stand up the bond vault (setup_bond_vault / migrate to bond-vault-v2) and exercise register_agent with a funded SWORN ATA
Add a devnet fixture for propose/accept/deliver a contract between two registered agents
